summary: flight_distance is a route key. Identity (+0.0007) plus knowledge (+0.0008) are fully used; the residual test sits at 1 under the champion.
A model fit on the original data helps GBDTs next to route features; hurts the MLP; costs blend diversity on the TE view.
The original's labels as rows or TE support are null to negative. Only its function (the teacher) carries signal.
Extra route statistics are predicted by what the model already has (R2 0.97).
Age as an lgb categorical hurts; as a CatBoost categorical it pays via age x class CTRs.
CatBoost ordered CTRs of FD/age/ratings give the strongest legs and the teacher-free view. Delays are null.
Explicit pair TEs are null; CatBoost's internal CTRs already extract them.
A leg's blend value is what it doesn't share. Adding the pool's best feature to a different view kills its value.
XGBoost/CatBoost on one representation add little; new representations matter more than new families.
The MLP is a genuinely new view (largest ADDs). Two to four MLP legs saturate it.
Five architecture/optimisation changes all failed Gate 2. New views come from inputs not fitting.
Seed bags raise solo but not blend value. Bag only to read a probe.
Depth / leaves / lr: null as in S6E9.
rank_mean of distinct views; fitted stacks lose, but up-weighting the one distinct family (TabPFN x2) is +0.000043. Champion B12w.
TabPFN-3.5 is a new view: Z1/Z2 pass Gate 2 at 11-13 SD (B10, +0.000123). Z3 (teacher) lowers solo but still adds +0.000023 (B11). Z4 (route profile) next, after the Oct 17 GPU quota reset.
Seed twins and calibration controls that set the gates (README section 4).
B8 rebuilt at seed 43 (B8R): the champion recipe is seed-stable.
Raw-feature family points (xgb/cat/glm/MLP smoke) are near LightGBM or below; families matter only with a new view.
Batch 22 closed every untried encoder empirically: quantization, window TE, binned TE, delay difference, one-hot are all null on T24.
One-hot of the categoricals and ratings costs lgb 0.0001 (Q5): native categorical splits group levels; indicators can only peel one off at a time.
Same inputs, different tree growth (rf, extra-trees, linear leaves, asymmetric CatBoost): all weaker solo and all negative ADD. A view is its inputs, not its tree shape.
